_comment: GROUND TRUTH for the money function (Cory, 2026-08-08). All objective math derives from this file — E[$] = Sum_w P(weekly-high, w)*weekly_high + P(RS champ)*rs_champ + P(RS 2nd)*rs_runner_up + Sum_k P(playoff finish k)*playoff[k]. Config-driven so a payout change is one file edit that trips the settings watchdog, never a code hunt. Re-verify against the league site's published structure if the commissioner edits payouts (pre-draft checklist line).

weekly_high.note: 37.5% of the pot — matchup-independent, paid to the league-high score each week. Variance is subsidized: this rewards pure ceiling against all 9 opponents simultaneously.

regular_season.tiebreak_note: Cory 2026-08-08: RS ties (incl. the runner-up / playoff-cut line) break on TOTAL POINTS-FOR. Corroborated by Cory's 2024 playoff miss on an 8.2-point tiebreak.
regular_season.note: Rewards consistent winning — the floor still buys RS money + playoff entry, so this is NOT a pure-ceiling league.

draft.note: Cory 2026-08-08: the draft is UNTIMED (corroborated by pick_timer=0 on the Sleeper draft object). The War Room / opening script drop HARD time-pressure cues; the LRM countdown stays — it counts PICKS, not seconds.

2023.note: Cory 2026-08-08 CONFIRMED 2023 (league year one) used a DIFFERENT payout structure — actual buy-in / pot / split still PENDING. Until the real 2023 values land, money_history's 2023 dollars are computed under the CURRENT structure and are ERA-MISMATCHED — flagged, not trusted. 2024 & 2025 use the current structure.

playoffs.note: Flat gradient: top-4 ENTRY (~$400 floor) is the real prize; seeding and winning add modestly. P(make top 4) matters more than P(win it).
